description: Tech explainer thumbnail: dark background, big glowing logo or icon, short punchy text.

fields.text: Short text (1-4 words). *word* = accent color, \n = new line
fields.icon: Big logo / icon image of the technology (PNG or SVG)
fields.emoji: Optional big emoji next to the text, e.g. 🔥 or 🤯
fields.sub: Optional small line under the text
fields.glow: Glow color behind the icon (default: accent2)
